attrs.evidence: Take the pins p₀, p₁ over |D| = 2 — whose refutation p₀(x) | p₁(x) is TWO constraints — and adjoin an irrelevant full k-ary relation. Every map preserves a full relation, so End(A) and the core are unchanged and the language still fails the property; but Σ|R^A| gains 2^k. Measured against the shipped kernel: k=1 gives Σ = 4 and a canonical construction of 8; k=4 gives 18 and 36; k=8 gives 258 and 516 — and at every k the two-constraint witness is still there, with both sites satisfiable, κ_splitBerge = 0 and an unsatisfiable union. AN UPPER BOUND ON THE MINIMUM BOUNDS NOTHING FROM BELOW. This record exists because R3.1 asserted the proposition above while citing FED-WITNESS-BOUND, which establishes the opposite direction; the family is pinned rather than the sentence merely deleted.
